fingridApiKey.title: Fingrid API key
fingridApiKey.description: Your own free key from data.fingrid.fi (developer portal > Open Data starter). Limits: 10,000 requests/24 h, 1 request / 2 s.

modes.title: Modes
modes.description: grid_snapshot, cheap_hours, co2, consumption_production, renewables, frequency, reserves, imbalance, custom

hoursBack.title: Hours back (history modes)
hoursBack.description: Number of hours of historical time-series data to fetch.

hoursAhead.title: Hours ahead (cheap_hours)
hoursAhead.description: Number of forecast hours ahead to rank for residual load.

topN.title: Cheap-hour candidates
topN.description: Number of lowest residual-load forecast hours to flag.

datasetIds.title: Dataset ids (custom mode)
datasetIds.description: Fingrid dataset ids; only Fingrid-produced CC BY datasets are accepted.
